Replace or optimize this PyTorch workload with a functionally equivalent GPU implementation. Preserve the input/output behavior and public model interface; use the benchmark evaluator to check correctness before reporting speedup.

## Complete reference workload and input contract

```python
import torch
import torch.nn as nn

class Model(nn.Module):
    """
    Simple model that performs a matrix multiplication, applies GELU, and then applies Softmax.
    """
    def __init__(self, in_features, out_features):
        super(Model, self).__init__()
        self.linear = nn.Linear(in_features, out_features)

    def forward(self, x):
        x = self.linear(x)
        x = torch.nn.functional.gelu(x)
        x = torch.nn.functional.softmax(x, dim=1)
        return x

batch_size = 1024
in_features = 8192
out_features = 8192

def get_inputs():
    return [torch.rand(batch_size, in_features)]

def get_init_inputs():
    return [in_features, out_features]
```
